page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfg7.24xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by the Intel Xeon 8369HB processor. It features 96 dedicated physical cores with a single thread per core, resulting in 96 vCPUs operating at a clock speed of 3.3 GHz. The system is equipped with 384.0 GB of system memory, providing a ratio of 4.0 GB of RAM per core. This instance does not include local storage or integrated GPU hardware, relying entirely on network-attached storage options. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 32 Gbps.

The instance utilizes a KVM hypervisor to deliver dedicated CPU allocation, ensuring that workloads do not share physical execution threads. This design provides predictable compute performance, though the lack of hyperthreading means the total thread count is limited to the physical core count. In terms of qualitative cost efficiency, the high-frequency CPU cores and dedicated resource allocation position this instance as a premium compute resource where CPU execution speed is prioritized over high memory density. The absence of bundled local storage requires external block storage provisioning, which represents a key architectural tradeoff for storage-heavy workloads.

Given the high clock speed of 3.3 GHz and dedicated physical cores, the ecs.hfg7.24xlarge is designed for compute-intensive applications. Suitable workloads include high-performance web serving, batch processing, scientific modeling, and enterprise applications that require consistent CPU performance without the overhead of multi-threading resource contention.
